records.title: Maximum Building Height
records.text: No residential building in zone Z1 shall exceed 15.0 metres in height, subject to road width norms under clause 2.1. [Amended (2024-06-15, fixture-amend-2024:3): After clause 2.2, the following clause shall be inserted: '2.2A Solar Rooftop Structures: Elevated solar panels up to 1.8 metres above the parapet are exempt from height calculation.']
